title: Microsoft Teams: audio announcement when recording or transcription starts
notes: claim 50: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: the policy commands, group-assignment path, default and rollout windows are supported. Its assurance that the feature adds no new data access is not documented and should be removed. Minor corrections should acknowledge the general Teams licensing requirement and the newer configuration guidance alongside the cmdlet references' unreleased-feature warning.

claims.where: controls[0].note; controls[1].note; What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The cmdlet reference pages warn that the feature is not fully released and the setting has no effect.
claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.
claims.fix: Keep the attributed reference warning, but add: 'Microsoft's configuration guidance also says to set RecordingAndTranscriptionAudioNotification to Enabled to turn on announcements; it does not repeat the no-effect warning.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/manage-meeting-recording-options#audio-announcements-for-recording-and-transcription. Replace the At rollout bullet about waiting for general availability with: 'Check rollout status and test the pilot: the cmdlet references warn that the setting has no effect while the feature is not fully released, whereas Microsoft's configuration guidance describes enabling it.'

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The Global meeting policy covers users who have no other policy assignment, while a custom meeting policy can target specific users.
claims.quote: To apply changes to all users in your organization who don't have an existing policy assignment, use the Global policy. To exclude certain users from the global policy, create and assign a custom meeting policy.

claims.where: controls[2].governs; Governance controls; Governance guidance
claims.claim: General meeting-policy group assignment can select which groups receive a policy with audio announcements enabled.
claims.quote: To enable announcements for specific users or groups instead, configure custom meeting and calling policies and assign those policies to the users or groups.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/manage-meeting-recording-options to sources for the documented connection between audio announcements and custom policy assignment. Keep controls[2]'s existing UI and API documentation links.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Meeting-policy and calling-policy announcements are configured separately rather than enabling one policy automatically enabling the other.
claims.quote:
For example, to enable announcements in the global meeting and calling policies, run:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -RecordingAndTranscriptionAudioNotification Enabled
Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity Global -RecordingAndTranscriptionAudioNotification Enabled
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/manage-meeting-recording-options for the separate meeting-policy and calling-policy configuration. Its guidance assigns meetings and group calls to meeting policy, and 1:1 VoIP calls to calling policy.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: MC1556096 and the two cited cmdlet references state no licence, add-on or meter specifically for this setting.
claims.quote: Searched: "RecordingAndTranscriptionAudioNotification" license pricing; "audio announcements for recording and transcription" "license" "price". Read MC1556096, both parameter sections and licence/price matches in both references; none names a licence or meter for this setting.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing is unknown because Microsoft has not published licensing for the setting.
claims.quote: Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included and add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/user-access to sources. Replace the broad licensing-unknown statements with: 'Teams users need a Microsoft Teams license, except when joining meetings anonymously. Microsoft has not published a licence, add-on or meter specific to this announcement setting.' Keep cost low; narrow the cost rationale's licensing caveat to licensing specific to this setting.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: cost; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No setting-specific price or consumption rate is published at the time of writing, so the known cost assessment concerns administration and communications.
claims.quote: Searched: "RecordingAndTranscriptionAudioNotification" license pricing; "audio announcements for recording and transcription" "license" "price". Opened both Set-CsTeams references, manage-meeting-recording-options and user-access; read overview excerpts. No setting-specific price or rate found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Neither the roadmap description nor MC1556096 says this setting changes recorded content or recording storage.
claims.quote: Searched: "RecordingAndTranscriptionAudioNotification" "storage" "recorded" "actions". Read the complete roadmap description and MC1556096; both describe announcement policy and neither specifies a change to captured content or storage.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The sources describe no action taken on anyone's behalf beyond the announcement.
claims.quote: Searched: "RecordingAndTranscriptionAudioNotification" "storage" "recorded" "actions". Read roadmap, MC1556096, both parameter sections and manage-meeting-recording-options. They describe policy-controlled notifications, not delegated or autonomous actions.

claims.where: rationale: risk
claims.claim: The feature adds no new data access.
claims.quote: Searched: "RecordingAndTranscriptionAudioNotification" "data access" permissions. Read roadmap, MC1556096, both parameter sections and manage-meeting-recording-options; search returned general transcript permissions, not a statement that this feature adds no data access.
claims.fix: Remove 'and the feature adds no new data access' from the risk rationale. Retain the documented off-by-default basis for the low risk rating.
